title: The Gas Pump Speed Trap Stealing Your Money

vo.en: Stop pumping gas at full speed.

visual.description: Close-up of a man's gloved hand violently squeezing a fuel pump trigger all the way down at a gas station.

vo.en: Squeezing that trigger to the max violently churns gasoline into an invisible vapor cloud.

visual.description: Macro shot of turbulent liquid splashing rapidly inside a glass container, releasing micro-droplets and rising vapor.

vo.en: Every modern pump nozzle has built-in suction tubes designed to vacuum up escaping fumes.

visual.description: Metallic industrial intake pipe with high-velocity air suction drawing in smoke and vapor particles.

vo.en: Here is the insane part: you already paid for that evaporated gas.

visual.description: Rapidly spinning digital numbers on a gas pump meter readout as money tallies up on screen.

vo.en: The digital meter charges your wallet, but those sucked-back fumes return straight to the underground station tank.

visual.description: Dark underground industrial fuel storage reservoir with pipelines directing liquid downward.

vo.en: Lock the pump handle on the lowest click to keep every drop dense and in your tank.

visual.description: Extreme close-up of a hand gently adjusting the metal latch of a pump handle to the first slowest notch.

vo.en: Subscribe now and comment your mileage boost after testing this trick, which is why you should...

visual.description: Driver's hand pressing the odometer trip reset button on a lit vehicle dashboard before driving onto the highway.
